prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 hero photograph for the What We Do page of Silvertide energy distribution. Create a distinct industrial logistics scene: elevated oblique aerial view of a coastal liquid bulk port on a clear cool morning, one unbranded product tanker moored parallel to a jetty, credible articulated loading arms and pipeline corridors leading inland to a cluster of large white cylindrical storage tanks, distant refinery. This must look like a broad operational supply-chain overview, with the ship smaller within the infrastructure, not a close-up vessel at sea. Water occupies the lower left 40% as calm navy negative space for white website typography, terminal and vessel occupy centre and upper right. Crisp realistic photography, slate-blue water, white steel tanks, pale sky, restrained amber details, coherent industrial geometry. No people, no logos, no text, no watermark, no shipping containers, no flames, no spills. Balanced composition usable as a full-width 2:1 crop.
